title: Rock Table

serves.summary: The learner sorts rocks and soils into groups by one property they can see or feel (colour, size or texture), which shows they can classify materials by an observable property.

request.topic: Sorting rocks and soil by what you can see and feel
request.objective: Sort rocks and soils into groups by one property you can see or feel (color, size or texture), keeping the other properties from deciding the group. (SCI003-02-A)

problems.ask: Sort the rocks by their color.
problems.goal: Rocks 1 and 4 (light) are in the tray with the light chip; rocks 2 and 3 (dark) are in the tray with the dark chip. All four are the same size and smooth, so only color can decide.

problems.ask: Sort the soils by how they would feel. Use the magnifier to look closer.
problems.goal: Piles 1 and 4 (sand: separate grains) are in the tray with the grain cluster; piles 2 and 3 (clay: smooth) are in the tray with the smooth smear. Each tray holds a light and a darker brown pile, so color did not decide.
